answer: Start from proof of sequential work with verifiable delay function. Every identity must clear it before its first answer counts. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 729 fakes spends 12393 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The kernel sits in the mechanism itself, the saffron sits in the price of faking it, and the dawn sits in the record no template can forge. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
